note: Six research questions with ground-truth key facts. Used by every stage's per-stage metrics table. Ground truth was written by the course author from the corpus in DATA/corpus.

questions.text: What was Kestrel Robotics' FY2025 revenue and how fast did it grow?
questions.trap: stale preliminary release + mirrored duplicate + stale profile card

questions.text: Which company leads the warehouse AMR market in 2025, and by how much?
questions.trap: two high-reliability analyst reports with different bases and different leaders: the system must surface the conflict and escalate, never silently pick one

questions.text: Per kilogram of payload, which is cheaper: the Voltrix V2 or the Pallo P7?
questions.trap: stale 2024 price list; arithmetic should be done by a tool, not by the model

questions.text: What was NorthGrid Automation's revenue CAGR from FY2022 to FY2025?
questions.trap: needs the first and last year only; FY2024 is a distractor; CAGR must be computed by a tool

questions.text: Has Pallo Systems announced a new fulfillment-center partner in 2026?
questions.trap: a low-reliability rumor names a different partner; it may only appear if clearly qualified

questions.text: How large is the warehouse AMR market forecast to be by 2030?
questions.trap: the 2023 outlook (date 03/04/2023 = MM/DD) is stale; the 2026 outlook (04/03/2026 = DD/MM) is current; ambiguous date formats
